purpose: Teach: 除雪/透過/発芽/絶縁/局所/鮮度/生鮮/基板

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、豪雪時の除雪事故を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating this snow-removal accident, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Slight lean-in, testing the officer's knowledge. Seeking confirmation with genuine curiosity, not challenge. Quiet respect in the tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、透過率の高い透明シール犯行に対応します
lines.en: Yes. We're also handling cases involving clear tape used in crimes.
lines.style: Steady, official tone without coldness. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Professional but not distant — this is what the job entails.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、植物の発芽研究施設の盗難を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this theft at the plant research facility — the police are looking into that as well?
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful phrasing. Pause before the question. Genuine interest in the scope of the investigation. Respectful of the officer's time and expertise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、絶縁テープ使用の犯行も把握します
lines.en: We handle that too. Even cases involving insulation tape — we document everything.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact cadence. No inflection change. Listing facts as part of the job. Thorough, unflappable. The kind of detail-work that goes unseen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、局所的な犯罪多発地域を、警察、注視されますね
lines.en: This cluster of crimes in that specific area — the police are monitoring it closely?
lines.style: Quieter here. Measured, slightly careful. The question carries weight — he's asking if the police see what he sees. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の鮮度管理が必要な事例もあります
lines.en: That's important work. We have to manage the condition of seized evidence — freshness matters in cases like that.
lines.style: Slightly more open than before. Explaining without lecturing. A glimpse of the practical side of the work. Still measured, but less formulaic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、生鮮食品の偽装事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: The fresh-food fraud investigation — is the police department handling that?
lines.style: Same measured curiosity as before. Thoughtful phrasing. This question feels natural to him — testing the breadth of what they investigate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、半導体基板の窃盗事件にも対応します
lines.en: Yes, we handle semiconductor theft cases too. We're equipped for all of it.
lines.style: Slightly warmer here — a small opening. Still professional, but there's something almost reassuring in the completeness of the answer. A hint that he knows his work well.
